copyrightStatus: Protected; no public-domain status or licence asserted.
purpose: Critical discussion of narrative geography: enacted scenes versus reported origins, itineraries, metaphors, depictions, historical allusions and unreliable statements. Every excerpt is attached to its own geographical-function assessment; fictional image anchors have separate interpretative notices.
necessity: Each selected literal clause is used to support the associated category or spatial relation. No chapter-level literary excerpts, long dialogue, substitute summaries, translated protected passages or continuous reading copy are published. Repeated genealogical clauses are counted in the aggregate.
proportionality: Selections are limited to the geographical propositions and minimal action needed for the analysis. They are dispersed among critical records, do not reproduce a continuous episode, and do not offer an alternative to reading the work. Brevity and attribution are not treated as a licence.
individualAssessments: work/mockingbird/verified-evidence.json; original clauses and source hashes retained locally.
publicationScope: Only the individually checked records are included. Broader candidate inventory remains explicitly in progress; no claim of completed addition.
